purpose: One repository-owned denominator for UI export names and deterministic release members.

dossier.decision_supported: Navigate the exact-source reference privately and decide whether a candidate is ready for owner acceptance.
dossier.gate_behavior: Never emitted by the release builder; deployment and served-hash verification require separate owner authority.
dossier.redaction: Only repository-approved client-free reference bytes may be hosted; deployment adds no evidence intake.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: external deployment only; not a release-manifest member
human_owned_evidence: private deployment authority not held by the builder
served-hash verification receipt required
limitations: hosting availability and access controls are external state
public publication is a separate prohibited-by-default decision

dossier.decision_supported: Query the curated reference and exact-source compiler summaries without scraping presentation formats.
dossier.gate_behavior: Emitted only after compiler, content, schema, privacy, and exact-source bindings validate; remains preview until release gates pass.
dossier.redaction: Contains safe reference metadata and compiler summaries, not restricted source text or client evidence.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; copied into offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: independent semantic review receipt required for verified status
limitations: machine readability does not imply behavioral verification
restricted content remains opaque

dossier.decision_supported: Orient to purpose, protected constraints, outcomes, decisions, and safe next actions.
dossier.gate_behavior: Generated from canonical content; blocked from verified publication when source or independent-review gates fail.
dossier.redaction: Client-free narrative only; no raw evidence, vault content, credentials, or restricted source.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: owner acceptance of product and decision framing required
limitations: summary navigation is not the complete source dossier
human decisions remain unresolved until their authority acts

dossier.decision_supported: Inspect architecture, completeness, source understanding, proof gaps, and release boundaries before change.
dossier.gate_behavior: Emitted as a source-bound dossier; unresolved parser, runtime, test, or review depth remains blocking or explicit.
dossier.redaction: Safe metadata and excerpts only; restricted files stay digest-only.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: critical/public symbol review receipts may still be required
limitations: static dossiers do not establish runtime behavior
coverage percentages are not correctness proof

dossier.decision_supported: Resolve any tracked path or symbol to its stable exact-tree record and lazy source location.
inputs: validated compiler file, line, symbol, test, workflow, dataset, claim, and graph indexes
dossier.gate_behavior: Fails with compiler/census mismatch; never synthesizes records for excluded or unreadable content.
dossier.redaction: Restricted paths expose classification and digest only; safe source remains in separate content-hashed chunks.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: independent census review required for complete-accounting approval
limitations: index presence is structural proof, not Level-4 explanation
dynamic runtime relationships can remain unresolved

dossier.decision_supported: Locate source and symbol records in a text-only environment.
dossier.gate_behavior: Generated only from the validated machine index; any mismatch fails release reconciliation.
dossier.redaction: Carries safe path and summary metadata, not restricted file contents.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: no separate human proof beyond the machine-index review
limitations: text companion is intentionally less complete than machine records and Source Explorer

dossier.decision_supported: Distinguish bounded current support from partial, missing, gated, excluded, and unknown capability debt.
dossier.gate_behavior: Catalog and gap reference failures block emission; non-current cells remain non-current.
dossier.redaction: Repository-owned capability metadata only; no estate adoption claim.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: owners must approve any support-state promotion
limitations: catalog breadth is versioned and never claims industry completeness
missing evidence is distinct from missing implementation

audience: product, security, privacy, and operations authorities
dossier.decision_supported: Compare human-owned decisions and unblended opportunity axes without a hidden ranking score.
dossier.gate_behavior: Open/gated decisions remain unresolved; the writer never converts a recommendation into authority.
dossier.redaction: Uses client-free decision metadata and no fabricated financial inputs.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: named human authority must resolve each decision
limitations: recommendations are advisory
value-of-information and ROI models remain incomplete

dossier.decision_supported: Define the smallest safe vertical slice for one exact gap, including do-nothing, proof, rollback, and residual limitations.
dossier.gate_behavior: Without an exact gap ID the member remains an explicit template; it grants no implementation or publication authority.
dossier.redaction: Contains repository-owned planning metadata only.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: target choice, acceptance, and verifier assignment remain human-owned
limitations: current closure is catalog-level and may not enumerate every affected symbol, test, GUI, or artifact

dossier.decision_supported: Resume bounded work with exact source, constraints, owners, gaps, and required verification visible.
dossier.gate_behavior: Generated as read-only context; it does not grant actions beyond a separately authorized task envelope.
dossier.redaction: No machine-local agent memory, raw vault content, client evidence, or credentials.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: task authority and completion verification remain external
limitations: context can become stale when detached from its source commit
the pack is not an autonomous authorization token

dossier.decision_supported: Inventory npm direct and transitive locked packages plus declared direct Python requirements for the bound build inputs.
dossier.gate_behavior: Dependency parse or source-binding failures block the release; missing Python transitive lock coverage and vulnerability applicability remain blocking separate gates.
dossier.redaction: Package metadata only; no credentials or local cache content is embedded.
validation: CycloneDX field and denominator contract checks
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: vulnerability/VEX applicability review is not supplied by the SBOM
limitations: Python coverage is direct declarations only because no transitive hash lock is owned
the official CycloneDX 1.5 schema is not executed by the current release builder
inventory does not prove absence of undeclared runtime materials
license and vulnerability status require separate current authority

dossier.decision_supported: Orient quickly to outcomes, capability posture, gaps, and exact-source release boundaries offline.
dossier.gate_behavior: Always labeled an executive navigation preview; cannot satisfy complete-viewer or source-accounting acceptance by itself.
dossier.redaction: Self-contained client-free HTML with no runtime fetch, analytics, persistence, restricted source, or raw evidence.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member and offline entry point; included in preservation bundle
human_owned_evidence: owner usability and accessibility review remain required
limitations: does not embed the complete safe source/line/graph payload
is not the private deployed application

dossier.decision_supported: Determine whether a PDF is absent, generated awaiting review, externally supplied, or visually verified.
dossier.gate_behavior: The ledger remains blocking until required PDF generation and independent visual verification are satisfied.
dossier.redaction: Carries status and digests only, never extracted document content.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: independent rendered-page visual QA receipt may be absent
limitations: gate status does not itself inspect page semantics or screen-reader quality

dossier.decision_supported: Read a paginated master reference and preserve an independently reviewed human document.
dossier.gate_behavior: Emitted only when a PDF is generated or supplied; never considered complete before render-and-verify evidence passes.
dossier.redaction: Client-free reference content only; restricted source remains summarized or opaque.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: conditional primary member; included in bundles only when present
human_owned_evidence: manual visual, print, and accessibility review required
limitations: PDF is not interactive Source Explorer
generation without review remains a preview

dossier.decision_supported: Identify exact source, curated inputs, dependency materials, tool versions, generated members, and known build boundaries.
dossier.gate_behavior: Missing or changed bound input blocks the build; provenance remains unsigned until the owner signs the manifest.
dossier.redaction: Uses tracked relative paths and digests; no private absolute path, secret, or raw restricted content.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in offline and preservation bundles
human_owned_evidence: owner signature and independent provenance review may be absent
limitations: provenance records declared build materials, not external hosting or human-process history

members.label: Offline reference and compiler projection ZIP

dossier.decision_supported: Use the executive view and complete safe compiler projection without network access.
dossier.gate_behavior: Deterministic archive generation requires exact validated inputs; complete-viewer claims remain blocked where the HTML is only executive navigation.
dossier.redaction: Includes only allowlisted safe compiler records/source chunks and approved release members.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; not nested inside itself
human_owned_evidence: offline usability and receiver verification exercise required
limitations: does not prove bare-machine recovery
executive HTML is not the complete interactive hosted UI

dossier.decision_supported: Retain exact source-bound records and declared recovery materials while exposing every missing external dependency.
dossier.gate_behavior: Archive emission does not clear recovery; the gate stays blocked until missing materials and exercises are independently satisfied.
dossier.redaction: Strict allowlist excludes secrets, owner keys, raw vault/client evidence, and machine-local memory.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; not nested inside itself
human_owned_evidence: 3-2-1 custody, bare-machine, checksum, key-loss, and schema-recovery exercise receipts are external
limitations: current pack intentionally lacks external caches/installers/keys identified by the coverage ledger

dossier.decision_supported: Distinguish materials present in the preservation ZIP from required external custody and missing recovery proof.
dossier.gate_behavior: Explicit missing/external items keep recovery status blocked rather than being treated as zero.
dossier.redaction: Lists material categories and states without private key locations or secret content.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; copied into preservation bundle
human_owned_evidence: external custody and exercise receipts are required and not inferred
limitations: ledger declaration is not evidence that an exercise succeeded

dossier.decision_supported: Recompute every emitted member digest and identify the exact release-family denominator before trust.
dossier.gate_behavior: Inventory is emitted unsigned; trust requires a later owner signature over the exact sibling release manifest that binds it.
dossier.redaction: Member paths, roles, sizes, and digests only; no embedded artifact payloads.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; intentionally excluded from its own denominator
human_owned_evidence: owner-controlled detached Ed25519 signature not generated by the builder
limitations: digest integrity does not establish authority, semantic correctness, or freshness

dossier.decision_supported: Confirm that the emitted family matches the single output-contract denominator and disclose conditional/external exclusions.
dossier.gate_behavior: A missing, extra, or misclassified member blocks release; attestation remains unsigned until manifest signature.
dossier.redaction: Names, roles, gates, and digests only.
dossier.distribution_inclusion: primary release member; included in the inventory and manifest
human_owned_evidence: owner signature and independent family review remain required
limitations: family completeness is relative to this versioned contract, not every conceivable output

dossier.decision_supported: Verify exact source, artifacts, exceptions, gates, ancestry, signature target, and release limitations offline.
dossier.gate_behavior: Generated manifest is an unsigned preview; VERIFIED/PUBLISHED status requires independent receipts and an external owner signature over these exact bytes.
dossier.redaction: Contains relative paths, digests, states, and limitations; private key and private custody locations never enter the repository.
validation: offline signature verification when signature exists
dossier.distribution_inclusion: canonical primary release member; detached signature remains external
human_owned_evidence: owner signature
independent release verdict
publication authority when applicable
limitations: unsigned manifests are previews
signature proves byte authorization, not semantic infallibility

disclosure: The detached signature is never generated by the release builder. The inventory becomes transitively signature-covered only when the owner signs the exact release-manifest bytes.
